name: Progress path climb
looks: A dotted path winds up across an illustrated landscape; a glowing marker travels along it as a cumulative total climbs in the corner. Named waypoints along the route light up and label themselves in turn as the marker reaches them, paying off with a glowing title over the illustration once the total completes.
build: Path is a fixed pre-drawn SVG route; the marker's position uses getPointAtLength driven by the same value powering the cumulative counter. Waypoint pill badges cross-fade from dim to lit the instant the marker passes, with a short pulse. The payoff title fades/scales in once the total reaches target, holding longer than other waypoints.
sound: A soft ambient bed under the climb, a chime on each waypoint unlocking, a fuller resolving chord on the final payoff.
prompt: Wind a dotted path across an illustrated landscape and travel a glowing marker along it as a cumulative total climbs, lighting up named waypoints in turn as the marker reaches them, and pay off the journey with a glowing title once the total hits its target.
